CustomField.description: Developer name of the Salesforce EmailTemplate used by the Form_Submission_Send_Start_Link autolaunched flow when a new Form Submission is inserted with Internal_Unique_Token__c populated (the admin-initiated invitation pattern). Leave blank to opt this template out of the invitation send — the package will not send an email for inserts on Form Templates where this field is blank.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: DeveloperName of the Salesforce EmailTemplate to use when the package sends an admin-initiated start-form invitation email. Leave blank to opt out — no invitation email is sent for inserts on this template.
CustomField.label: Email Template Name (Start Form)
